titlePlain: Encryption at Rest: How Cloud Providers
subtitle: Lesson 9 · Cloud Encryption: At Rest and In Transit

code:
Azure Storage Accounts   -> AES-256, on by default
Azure Managed Disks      -> AES-256, on by default
Amazon S3                -> AES-256, on by default
Amazon EBS volumes       -> AES-256, on by default

No switch to flip. No code to write.
caption: The provider generates the key, encrypts before writing, decrypts on an authorized read.

eyebrow: What it does NOT protect against
code:
Leaked access key        -> still reads plaintext
Over-permissioned role   -> still reads plaintext
Compromised admin login  -> still reads plaintext

The platform decrypts transparently for any
request it considers authorized.
